messages:
noah: spotted another oddity in canary: lots of 1-2 token provisional charges during mid-request reconnects. looks like truncation + retry path is double-counting prefixes when toolcall switches to streaming.

rita: ugh. any sample traces?

noah: pasted one from router+backend chain:
```
[2026-06-10T15:22:01Z] client=mobile-42 session=sess-A reconnect -> new session sess-B
[2026-06-10T15:22:01Z] router -> backend path=/v1/toolcall mode=streaming header:x-session=sess-B
[2026-06-10T15:22:01Z] backend provisional_charge tokens=2 reason=prefix-capture
[2026-06-10T15:22:02Z] client retries resume with sess-B offset=0
[2026-06-10T15:22:02Z] backend confirmed_charge tokens=15
```

mike: so provisional rows are emitted twice across reconnects? is tombstone/dedupe window too short?

noah: looks like tombstone helped for full confirmations but streaming prefix tokens sometimes re-emit because the toolcall path had `truncate_on_reconnect=true` and we don't prop orig-session metadata through the proxy.

rita: two approaches: (A) propagate x-original-session-id from router to backend so dedupe can match prefixes OR (B) keep provisional but tag with metadata (probe/reconnect/short-duration) and use reconcile rules to collapse and refund.

mike: prefer (A) for correctness, but (B) gives better auditability during rollout. also console needs visibility to avoid chasing false positives.

noah: agree. small hybrid: propagate x-original-session-id and also emit provisional tags: {"reconnect":true, "orig_session":<id>, "client_agent":<ua>}. ledger will keep rows but with tags. reconcile job will auto-adjust only after 24h if confirmed_rate<3%.

billing-bot: FYI we will need an exportable CSV of provisional groups with tags so finance can validate before issuing refunds. created billing-ticket BILL-431.

console-bot: putting up CON-520 to add a "provisional tag" filter and conversion-rate viz per route + sample traces for low-duration sessions. will also add an allowlist toggle for known mobile UA strings.

rita: deployment plan: router header propagation behind FF, backend accepts header and dedupes for 1 minute tombstone window, ledger stores tagged provisional, reconcile runs after 24h and exports candidate refunds. test matrix: 1) pure probe traffic (ALB healthchecks) 2) mixed probes+real retries 3) poor-net mobile clients to check false positives.

mike: QA note: simulate interleaved reconnects with variable truncation lengths and assert provisional->confirmed collapse rate for real clients stays >98% and probe false-confirm rate <2%.

noah: I'll open PR for router change and a small backend change to read x-original-session-id. will coordinate with console team for dashboard tiles and billing for CSV.

rita: thanks. also add a safety knob: no auto-refunds until FF at 100% AND billing signoff.

mike: fine. follow ups tracked in INFRA-1024, BILL-431, CON-520. closing for now. :rocket:
